主机可单独覆盖。仅影响新上传；目标变化时仍需确认，永不自动回车。: Hosts can override this. Applies to new uploads; target changes still require confirmation. Never presses Enter.

默认使用复制、粘贴等普通菜单。Shift＋右键临时使用普通菜单；仅识别应用附着的: The default menu provides copy and paste. Shift-right-click always uses the normal menu. Only tmux sessions attached through Farport are recognized.
；已按设置等待手动插入。: ; waiting for manual insertion as configured.

监控响应无法识别；未展示推测数据。: Unrecognized monitoring response. No guessed metrics are displayed.

当前显示上次成功采样，不是实时数据。: Showing the last successful sample, not live data.
只读 · 不安装组件 · 不自动提权 · 离开页面停止采集: Read-only · No installation or elevation · Stops when you leave
整机 0–100%；首次采样可能无数据: Host CPU: 0–100%; first sample may be unavailable
最近 15 分钟 · 仅保留本次连接内存记录: Last 15 minutes · In-memory history for this connection only

可见进程 {0} 个。只读查看，不提供结束进程操作。: {0} visible processes. Read-only; no process termination actions.
网卡流量：接收为下行，发送为上行。虚拟网卡可能重复计数，因此不合并为整机总速率。: Per-interface traffic: receive is download, send is upload. Virtual interfaces may duplicate traffic, so rates are not combined.
没有可见端口；权限或工具限制见下方说明。: No visible ports. Check permissions and tool limitations below.
仅显示当前连接用户，不读取密码、密钥、环境变量或硬件序列号。: Shows the connected user only. Passwords, keys, environment variables, and hardware serial numbers are not collected.
Termux 只能显示 Android 允许当前应用访问的资源；没有 root: Termux only exposes resources Android permits this app to read. Without root, system-wide processes and ports are usually unavailable.
Windows 采集适配已提供，但尚未完成 Windows 真机运行验收。: A Windows collector is provided, but has not yet been validated on a real Windows host.
— 表示不可用或尚无差分采样，不代表零。内存口径由各系统提供，不宜直接跨系统对比: — means unavailable or awaiting another sample, not zero. Memory definitions differ by operating system.
进程范围受当前用户权限限制；Linux 用户列可能显示 UID。: Process visibility depends on user permissions; Linux may show numeric UIDs.
进程级带宽：当前免安装模式不可用，不用网卡流量冒充进程流量。: Per-process bandwidth is unavailable in agentless mode. Interface traffic is not presented as process traffic.
端口关联 PID 仅在系统允许时显示，不自动请求管理员权限。: Port owners are shown only when permitted. Administrator rights are never requested automatically.
Windows 进程所属用户未采集；当前登录用户见系统信息。: Windows process owners are not collected. See System & user for the connected account.
当前权限或工具无法读取整机 CPU。: Host CPU metrics cannot be read with the available permissions or tools.
当前权限或工具无法读取可比较的内存用量。: Memory usage cannot be read with the available permissions or tools.
无法读取网卡计数器；检查目标权限或系统工具。: Network counters are unavailable. Check target permissions and tools.
端口工具缺失或权限不足，无法列出端口。: Port tools are missing or permissions do not allow listing ports.

当前权限无法列出进程。: Processes cannot be listed with current permissions.

请输入名称和单行命令；不允许换行或控制字符，也不会自动回车。: Enter a name and a single-line command without line breaks or control characters. Enter is never sent automatically.
请输入有效的桌面 IP 或域名及 1–65535 端口，不要输入账号、密码或 U: Enter a desktop IP or hostname and a port from 1 to 65535, without credentials or a URL.

SSH 主机可访问的 Mac 地址: Mac address reachable from the SSH host
SSH 主机就是目标 Mac 时使用 127.0.0.1；若它只是跳板，请填写跳: Use 127.0.0.1 when the SSH host is the Mac itself. For a gateway, enter the Mac address reachable from it. Standard screen sharing only; High Performance is not promised.
仅在可信网络中直连；不会自动改走 SSH。请勿将 VNC 端口暴露到公网。: Connect directly only over trusted networks. SSH is not used automatically. Do not expose VNC ports to the internet.
账号由苹果屏幕共享窗口处理：使用目标 Mac 已授权的系统用户，不是 iClou: Apple Screen Sharing handles authentication with an authorized user of the destination Mac, not an iCloud login. Farport does not enable a legacy VNC password, collect desktop passwords, or change remote services.
SSH 模式下系统窗口显示本机转发地址，请核对此处的真实目标。此功能仍需目标 M: With SSH, the system window shows a local forwarding address. Verify the real destination here. Real-Mac testing of system accounts, locked screens, and credential isolation is still required.
桌面通道与终端独立；关闭此面板不会断开。退出 Farport 会关闭 SSH 桌: Desktop channels are independent of terminals and this panel. Quitting Farport closes SSH desktop channels. Direct connections are managed by Screen Sharing.
主机配置已变化，请关闭后重新打开桌面入口。: The host configuration changed. Close and reopen the desktop panel.
在空窗口恢复布局；不会重放命令。: Restore the layout in an empty window. Commands are never replayed.
需要可信 OSC 7 目录报告；不修改远端 Shell。: Requires a matching OSC 7 directory report. Remote shells are not modified.
主机已移除或连接配置已变化，请重新收藏目录。: The host was removed or its connection changed. Bookmark the directory again.
只保存手动添加的单行命令，不记录终端输入。请勿保存密码。插入后需自行回车。: Only manually added single-line commands are saved. Terminal input is not recorded. Do not store passwords. Press Enter yourself after inserting.
没有选中的终端；可以先保存命令。: No terminal selected. You can still save commands.
请先退出全屏终端程序，确认位于 Shell 提示符后再插入命令。: Leave the full-screen terminal program and verify you are at a shell prompt before inserting a command.
目标终端已变化、断开或不符合适用主机；请重新打开命令面板。: The terminal changed, disconnected, or is outside the command's host scope. Reopen the command panel.
请在空窗口恢复工作区，现有终端不会被替换。: Restore in an empty window. Existing terminals will not be replaced.
已跳过删除或连接配置已变化的主机；未向它们发起连接。: Removed or changed hosts were skipped. No connections to them were started.
终端尚未报告可信目录。需要 OSC 7 Shell 集成；tmux 或主机不匹配: No matching directory report yet. OSC 7 shell integration is required. Browse manually for tmux or a mismatched host.
无法读取工作工具记录；原文件未修改，请先检查数据目录。: Workspace tools could not be loaded. The original file is unchanged. Check the data directory first.
未完成的任务会保留断点。SSH 终端和桌面通道将关闭；远端 tmux 会话不会因: Unfinished transfers keep their checkpoints. SSH terminals and desktop channels will close; remote tmux sessions will not be terminated.
